description: Get the driver's recorded GPS route (breadcrumb trail) for a booking's trip — the path the driver actually drove, with a distance/duration summary. Use for route playback or to verify a driver attended. Trail is recorded only while the driver is on the job and kept for 30 days. Needs the booking reference (and the passenger email unless you're internal staff using the numeric reservation ID).

booking_ref.description: Booking reference — "APL-<LT reservation id>" (e.g. "APL-1013869") or the numeric LT reservation ID.

email.description: Passenger email on the booking (required for partner/customer lookups; optional for internal staff using a numeric reservation ID).

name: get_driver_route
title: Get Driver Route
